name: Repair
description: You touch an object that has been damaged such as something that has been broken into no more than 4 pieces, been ripped, torn or cracked and magically repair it.

name: Modify Weight
description: You touch an object that is not being held or equipped by another creature and modify its mass, either causing it to be twice as heavy or half as heavy while you focus on this spell. The object must fit into an area less than 2 cubic units in size.
chargeeffect: You can target a mutable weapon, causing a 1d4 penalty to any attack checks made with it while you maintain your focus.

name: Transmute Projectile
description: In response to a projectile targeting you or a creature within 3 units, you roll a spell attack against the attack check. If your result is higher, you reduce the primary damage of the projectile by transmuting it into something harmless like dust or wildflowers.

name: Messenger
description: You magically fold a piece of paper into the shape of an avian creature and command it to fly to a specific location on your current plane. Upon reaching the destination, the messenger unfolds itself leaving the original paper.

name: Transmute Object
description: You touch an object that can fit within 1 cubic unit and transmute it into another object of a similar size as long as you focus on this spell. The material of the object remains the same. This spell cannot be used on objects that are currently equipped.

name: Elastic Strike
description: You touch a creature and allow their limbs to stretch beyond their normal limits. Until the end of your next turn, that creature gains an extra unit of reach on their melee attacks and is not affected by cover on those attacks.

name: Disfiguring Jolt
description: You target a creature and attempt to violently alter their appearance by launching a magical projectile at them, dealing arcane damage as well as giving them a minor cosmetic disfigurement that lasts until they complete their next full rest. Examples of disfigurements include making a creatures nose twice as large, causing swelling or changing the color of a body part or hair. On a true hit, the disfigurement can either blind, deafen or mute a creature until the end of their next turn.
chargeeffect: The spell deals no damage but any hit is upgraded to a true hit

name: Transmute Liquid
description: You target a container or area of liquid that fits within 1 cubic unit and change its form into either blood, ale, wine or water. The liquid reverts back to its original form after your next full rest.

name: Beckon
description: You target a small, unequipped object that has a mass less than your spell damage bonus modifier that is within 6 units and has a clear, straight path to you and bring it to you, equipping the item into an empty hand.

name: Vanishment
description: You target an object within 10 units and attempt to vanish it by rolling a spell attack of 10 or higher. While you focus on this spell, the object disappears and is unusable. If the object is currently equipped by another creature, the check is increased by 5. If you focus on this spell for 1 minute, the object is transported to a random location in the void plane. This spell does not work on objects that are immutable or contain lead.

name: Levitate
description: You touch a creature or object that fits within 1 cubic unit and cause it to hover for 1 minute. A creature affected in this way gains a hover speed equal to your spell damage bonus modifier for the duration of the spell.

name: Expose
description: You target a creature within 10 units and attempt to reveal its true form. On a success, you learn the creature type of your target as well as see an aura or silhouette of the creatures true form.

name: Extended Leap
description: You touch a creature and grant their next jump action within the next minute extra units equal to your spell damage bonus modifier. Additionally, they can jump this distance without requiring movement.

name: Fabricate
description: You create a basic weapon or ammunition from any type or combination of metal where the value of the created item is less than or equal to the total value of components used. The shape and design of the object are to be determined by you. This spell can also be used to decrease the total cumulative check of an object that is in the process of being crafted with 10gp of metal by 1d4. An unfinished object can only be the target of this spell once.
components: Metal in equal or greater value than the created object

name: Aquafy
description: You touch a creature and cause them to grow gills that last for 4 hours and cause webbing to grow on their hands and feet. While under the effect of this spell, a creature has a swim speed equal to their move speed and can breathe underwater.

name: Telekinesis
description: You target a small object within 10 units that has a mass less than or equal to your spell damage bonus modifier and move it with your mind up to 10 units from its starting position. You can use this object as a projectile to strike another creature, dealing physical damage but releasing your hold on the object.
chargeeffect: Double the spell damage bonus modifier and mass limit

name: Fracture
description: You target a creature or object within 6 units and attempt to break them, dealing physical damage. Objects and constructs take an additional 1d8 damage.

name: Reduction
description: When a spell or effect with an area is channeled or activated within 4 units of you, you may shrink its size. Reduce either the radius, cone length, or line width by 1 unit, down to a minimum of 1 unit.

name: Mattershift
description: In response to a spell being channeled within 12 units of you that deals elemental damage, you change all elemental damage to your choice of physical, lightning, fire, or cold.

name: Unlock / Lock
description: You target a lock and use your spell attack as your check to attempt to unlock it. This spell can also be used to create a lock with the required check of opening it being equal to your spell attack, using an iron ingot as a component.

name: Conjure Feast
description: You materialize a feast capable of providing 14 meals. Anyone who consumes at least 1 meal gains temporary health equal to your spell damage modifier after completing their next full rest.

name: Reversion
description: You target an object or creature within 12 units that has been transformed by magic, alchemy or disease into another creature or object and attempt to change it back into its original form. This spell works automatically unless the spell that caused the effect is expert or master level, in which case the required checks are 12 and 15.

name: Animorphosis
description: You target an object within 6 units and transform it into a beast that resembles the objects likeness of a level less than your spell damage bonus modifier. For example, you may attempt to turn a rope into a snake, a pile of buttons into a swarm of insects or a carving of a bird into an eagle. The beast is considered wild and is not under your control. This spell lasts as long as you maintain focus or the beast reaches 0 health.

name: Fusion Ray
description: You shoot a ray of random energy at a target within 14 units and roll 1d4 to determine the damage type (1> fire 2> cold 3> lightning 4> physical).
chargeeffect: Large or smaller creatures are shoved 2 units

name: Obscure
description: You target a creature within 8 units and obscure their form, making them more difficult to hit. For the next 5 minutes, your target gains a +2 bonus to stealth checks and +1 to block, dodge and resistance checks.
chargeeffect: The spell requires focus but does not consume components

name: Breaching Beam
description: You launch a ray at a creature within 12 units and choose an elemental damage type that they will become vulnerable to. While you focus on this spell, whenever your target takes damage of the chosen type, they take additional damage equal to your spell damage bonus modifier.
chargeeffect: The creature becomes vulnerable to all elemental damage

name: Chassis
description: You target a creature within 8 units and surround them in a shield of energy. While you focus on this spell, the interior of this shield is filled with breathable air and protects against excessive heat, electrouction and freezing temperatures.

name: Suspend
description: You touch a large or smaller creature and cause them to rise 3 units into the air. While you focus on this spell, the creature cannot move unless they have a hover or fly speed.

name: Shapeshift
description: You shape your body into a humanoid that you have seen before while you focus on this spell. You are a near identical copy, but you are only able to replicate parts of them that you have seen. While you are in this form, you have their might and agility attributes but retain your other skills.

name: Shield of Transmutation
description: You create a spherical shield with a radius of 4 units centered on you. While you focus on this spell, any time a creature within the area is targeted by a ray or projectile from outside the shield consumes 2 power from your conduit, but grants them a 1d4 bonus to their defensive check. On a success, the projectile or ray is transmuted into something harmless.
chargeeffect: The radius of the spell is increased by 2

name: Transmute Metal
description: You touch a metal object or surface that can fit within a 1 cubic unit and transmute it into water, ice or steam. Lead alloys, aetherium and starsteel are not affected by this spell. If this spell targets an object equipped or held by a creature, it becomes a Touch attack.

name: Anomoly
description: You manipulate gravity and create a shock of force at a point within 10 units with a radius of 3 units. Any creature that is large or smaller within that area must make a contested strength check or be pulled 1 unit towards the center of the area, taking true damage. This spell deals splash damage.
chargeeffect: The radius of the spell is increased by 2

name: Fly
description: You touch a willing creature and grant them a flight speed equal to your spell damage bonus modifier as long as you focus on this spell.

name: Crushing Force
description: You target a creature within 8 units and bring down a crushing force on them, dealing true damage. On a true hit, large or smaller creatures become prone.
chargeeffect: The true hit requirement for knocking the target prone is removed, but the size is reduced to medium or smaller creatures

name: Alter Size
description: You touch a willing creature and cause them to permanently change their size to either small, medium or large.

name: Become Stone
description: You touch a creature and dedicate your focus to begin the process of transforming them into stone. If the creature drops below 20 health while under the effects of this spell, they turn to stone and gain the stasis condition. While they are transformed in this way, they are considered an impervious and sturdy object. If the object reaches 0 health, it shatters and the original creature dies.

name: Omnikinesis
description: You target a creature that is large or smaller within 16 units and move it a number of units equal to your spell damage bonus modifier. If the creature collides with another creature who fails a check against a projectile attack using the original spell attack check, both creatures take damage. If the creature collides with an object, both the object and creature take damage. You can also target an object that is less than 300 mass and fits within a 3 cubic unit area.

name: Metamorphosis
description: You transform into an elemental or construct of a level less than your spell damage bonus modifier for 1 hour. While transformed in this way, you can channel spells you or the creature know using power from your conduit. When this spell ends due to time or reaching 0 health, you transform back, reverting back to the health you had before you transformed.

name: Mattermorph
description: You target a creature within 14 units that is of a level less than your spell damage bonus modifier and turn them into a tiny object. This spell ends when the object is destroyed, otherwise the creature remains within stasis.

name: Alter
description: You touch a creature and permanently morph their form. You can either add or remove an appendage, increase or decrease their age by up to 10 years, or cosmetically alter them in some other way. Additionally, conditions that normally would not be able to be removed due to physical limitations can be cured by this spell.

name: Manipulate Gravity
description: You create an area the size of 20 cubic units where gravity is lessened while you maintain focus on this spell. While in this area, creatures can move vertically using their move speed and all jump distances and projectile ranges are doubled.

name: Renewal
description: You touch a creature that has died within the past day and repair their body, allowing a willing soul to return to it. The body is cured of any conditions that were affecting it as well as any permanent damage such as scars or missing limbs. The affected creature gains full health but remains unconscious for 1 hour.

name: Erase Matter
description: You target an area within 14 units that fits within 2 cubic units and destroy everything inside. Instead of making a spell attack, you roll damage. For each non-immutable creature completely within this area, compare your total damage against their remaining health. If the damage is greater, that creature is erased from existence, otherwise the creature does not take damage. Objects or parts of objects fail this check automatically unless they are immutable.
